args: Run the daily ConnectPilot automation located at <ABSOLUTE_REPO_PATH>. Execute `<ABSOLUTE_VENV_PYTHON> <ABSOLUTE_REPO_PATH>/main.py --limit 15` to send 15 connection requests using the dedicated persistent browser profile (never close or modify the user's personal browser). After it finishes, run `<ABSOLUTE_VENV_PYTHON> <ABSOLUTE_REPO_PATH>/cli.py stats` and provide a concise summary including: (1) a numbered list of every person sent a connection request in this run with their clickable LinkedIn profile link formatted as `[Name](https://www.linkedin.com/in/.../)`, (2) any errors encountered, (3) the updated search page saved in .env, and (4) the remaining daily/weekly quota.
description: Every day at 7:00 AM (<IANA_TIMEZONE>), sends 15 LinkedIn connection requests automatically and reports daily/weekly connection statistics.
